scenes.title: Devotional
scenes.description: King David was considered a man after God's own heart, because he obeyed Him and loved God so much that he longed to please Him.

scenes.title: As a young man
scenes.description: He helped his father take care of the sheep, working diligently.

scenes.title: God chose him
scenes.description: He was anointed king by the prophet Samuel and always remained humble before Saul.

scenes.title: Facing death
scenes.description: Saul wanted to kill him, and he hid in caves, hungry and in need, but always faithful to God.

scenes.title: The persecution lasted ten years
scenes.description: When Saul died, David grieved for someone who had wanted to kill him, because his love was true.

scenes.title: King David
scenes.description: He strengthened the kingdom and put God at its center. He organized worship and expressed his relationship with God through the Psalms.

scenes.title: David dances for God
scenes.description: His devotion showed in his joy: he danced before the ark when it was carried to Jerusalem, even though others thought it was humiliating.

scenes.title: David longs to build a house for God
scenes.description: The prophet Nathan told him that it would not be he, but his son, who would build it, and David gathered all the materials for his son.

scenes.title: The Davidic Covenant promise
scenes.description: God promises that his descendants would have an everlasting kingdom, through which Christ, the Son of God, would come!

scenes.title: David is forgiven
scenes.description: Although he sinned, he repented deeply, as Psalm 51 reflects: Create in me, O God, a CLEAN HEART.
